title: WDFireball
description: The firebomb datapack that even Tang Long swears by! Using this makes taking down the Warden as easy as breathing!
body:
🔥 Enhanced Fire Charge Data Pack 🔥
This lightweight data pack significantly expands the tactical depth and fun of the Fire Charge, all without altering its original vanilla functionality.

✨ Core Features

🟢 Pure Vanilla, Seamless Integration

100% Vanilla Compatibility: Works perfectly with dispensers, brewing lingering potions, and as crossbow ammunition.

Zero Learning Curve: Fully compatible with vanilla items, recipes, and mechanics.
✨ New Action: The Throw

New "Throw" Action: When holding a Fire Charge, simply perform a right-click to throw it, just like an Ender Pearl!

Impact Explosion: The thrown Fire Charge will explode and ignite the area upon impact, providing you with a fast and flexible medium-range fire attack option.

⚡ Ultra-Optimized & Lightweight
Minimal Resource Usage: Highly optimized code focused on core functionality. It runs smoothly even on servers with almost zero additional overhead.

🛠️ Highly Customizable
Built-in Quick Config Tool: Access the configuration menu easily via in-game commands.

🎇You can combine Fire charge with a quantity of gunpowder that is a multiple of two at the crafting table to create Fireballs with different explosive power!

Adjustable Settings Include:

Explosion Power

Visual Effect Toggles

And more...

📥 Installation & Usage

Place the data pack into your world's datapacks folder.

Reload or enter your world; the features activate automatically.

Type /reload in-game to receive instructions.

Use the provided command to obtain the configuration tool and adjust the "Rules of Fire" to your liking!

Add a cool burst of flames to your Survival, PVP, or Adventure gameplay!
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
🔥 增强火焰弹数据包 🔥
这个轻量级数据包在不改变原版火焰弹功能的前提下，极大地扩展了火焰弹的战术与趣味性。

✨ 核心特点：

原汁原味，无缝集成

✅ 100%保留原版所有功能：可用于发射器、酿造滞留药水、作为弩的弹药。

与原版物品、合成表及机制完美兼容，无需学习成本。

全新操作：投掷攻击

🙋‍♀️🙋‍♀️多人兼容游玩，不仅自己享受被火焰弹撅的乐趣

✨ 新增“投掷”操作：手持火焰弹时，右键单击即可像末影珍珠一样将其投掷出去！

投掷出的火焰弹在撞击后会爆炸并点燃区域，为你提供一种快速、灵活的中距离火焰攻击手段。

极致优化，轻量如羽

⚡ 超低资源占用：代码高度优化，专注于核心功能。在服务器上运行也几乎不产生额外负担，确保游戏流畅。

高度可定制，随心所欲

🛠️ 内置快捷配置工具：通过简单的游戏内快捷操作即可打开配置菜单。

🎇你可以使用烈焰弹和以二为倍数的火药数量在合成台合成不同爆炸威力的火焰弹！

可自定义选项包括：

爆炸威力

以及更多视觉效果开关…

📥 安装与使用：

将数据包放入世界datapacks文件夹。

重载或进入世界，功能自动启用。

进游戏内输入/reload获取提示。

使用提供的命令获取配置工具，调整属于你自己的火焰法则！

为你的生存、PVP或冒险增添一抹炫酷的火焰！
